summary: Consolidate existing verification, review, impact, and selected specialist reports into one evidence-backed quality assessment.

inputs.name: change-set
inputs.description: Immutable external or internally produced candidate under assessment.

inputs.name: verification-report
inputs.description: Observed verification, including failures, blocks, and gaps.

inputs.name: review-report
inputs.description: Observed review findings and independently identified reviewer.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Quality scope and required vs. omitted quality dimensions.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Known authoritative criteria and quality constraints.

completion_checks: The consolidated verdict reflects actual status and findings from every selected report; a failed/blocked/inconclusive source never becomes a quality pass.
Each finding and dimension references retained evidence or a clearly identified gap.
Independent review claims are supported by host-supplied provenance; omitted checks and remediation boundaries remain visible.
failure_modes: No inspectable fixed subject or required report is available: blocked.
Required evidence is stale or independence/coverage cannot be established: inconclusive.
At least one required criterion or unresolved blocking finding is demonstrably violated: failed.
